src/AgentOrchestrator.CodeQuality.note: Only non-web dependency is CodingAgentRunner (agent execution client). No Microsoft.AspNetCore.* package anywhere in the tree.

src/QualityStudio.Api.note: Only project in the solution using the Web SDK. Hosts the core behind HTTP for the browser UI.

src/quality-cli.note: Full-surface CLI: review, security, boundaries, flow, report, diff, scan. Already consumes the core in-process via ProjectReference.

src/quality.note: Narrower dotnet-tool surface (scan, diff, security). Distinct packaging target from quality-cli; both build an executable literally named quality.

shape: star topology: AgentOrchestrator.CodeQuality is the hub; QualityStudio.Api, quality-cli, and quality are independent spokes that each take a plain ProjectReference to it. No project currently reaches the core through HTTP.
